notes.title: Midnight Monitor: Summer Sale! (+ Upcoming Updates)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, and thank you for your interest in Midnight Monitor!

The series will be discounted for this year's Steam Summer sale, so this is a great opportunity to grab the full series for a steep discount if you are still missing any of the games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39019/Midnight_Monitor_Complete_Bundle/

Midnight Monitor: Anomaly Watch... Update?
You bet! It's currently in the works and there isn't a definite ETA, but I am currently working on adding a hub area to Anomaly Watch. This will replace the main menu and will allow you to jump into any of the levels, collect rewards and vibe in a small space that you can't escape from!

The more you play Anomaly Watch (+ Aldercourt!) the more emails you unlock, the more unique items you unlock, and the more you learn about the secrets behind SEQURE, the Midnight Monitor security system and more...

Also, you can pick up and throw most objects. Some of them squeak!

It is planned that this update will bring Anomaly Watch out of Early Access - Get hyped!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889713/a78c767c1a92afa0c95d8c640889a8f63230152b.gif

What's Next?

In addition to this large content update for Anomaly Watch, there are still some small bug fixes planned for Aldercourt, and then we move onto game #3...

What could it be 🤔

Thank you as always for supporting me and my game development, and I hope all have a wonderful Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: 2.0 Update - New Anomalies, A New Room, Interactivity!
notes.content:
Thank you for your support in the development of Midnight Monitor: Aldercourt, and for your patience in waiting for content updates.

Midnight Monitor: Aldercourt has now been updated to V 2.0.0!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889713/bd5547e5355025be985363e76d7930310818985a.png

MAJOR CHANGES

For Returning Players

 The game will ask if you want to reset your anomaly checklist - This will not affect other data, such as your wins or loops through the station. This simply sets your anomalies seen to 0 and creates a backup of your existing anomaly data in your save data location


Total Anomalies - 80

 The number of total anomalies has been raised from 55 to 80.
 New jumpscares, hilarious anomalies, weird stuff & more!
 One of the anomalies can function as a "hint" system, but be warned...
 ... We've been forced to add an "Alternative Ending"
 Anomaly spawn rates have been tweaked to provide a more challenging and rewarding experience



Player Interactivity

 Many objects in Aldercourt Station can now be picked up, rotated, moved and interacted with
 Additional controls for this new feature can be found under the in-game pause menu
 Added poster surfing - Jump on your favourite poster and pull up!
 The player is advised NOT to pet the new pettable dog that has been added
 A brand new interactive piano has been added, developed by Thorlar International Labs in collaboration with Aldercourt City Council


New Room: Restroom

 A brand new room has been added - The restroom
 Interact with the door to check the restroom for anomalies during each loop
 An existing anomaly has been altered to better fit this new feature (also including a new achievement 👽)
 Click the duck


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889713/6ecf68f817c34f0ab4571cdb87541e4298536bce.png

Easy Mode

 Ensures that the player score is reduced by 1 when incorrectly moving through Aldercourt station (instead of resetting to 0)


Speedrun Mode

 A new built-in speedrun mode has been added to the main menu
 Speedrun mode disables "Prioritise New Anomalies" and "Easy Mode"
 The fastest recorded speedrun is saved to a plaque on the Main Menu


New Achievements

 Throwing away trash? Seeing 68.75% of all anomalies? Best Game Ever


Thank you, Supporters!

 Supporter content has been added to the game in the form of Station PA Announcements
 New Announcement Frequency option - "Too Frequent" (Messages play back to back)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889713/f1c9de4ef0f40cb2b42614a9f3a1ecb2dc6b91b2.png

Quality of Life changes

 Controls screen added to pause menu
 Increased Player sprinting speed from 175% to 225%
 Added volume slider for Jumpscares - Turn them down, or turn them off completely
 Added sticky notes with hints, musings, and lore penned by the trusty station Janitor
 Added granular save data management options
 The anomaly checklist now shows alternate letters of unseen anomalies' names
 Added a quick restart button to the pause menu
 Altered the spawn location of the ball to better signpost the full functionality of a certain sporty anomaly


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889713/168bdd049a734c29eec472ec2cfac40523e6fbda.png

Social

 Social buttons have been added to the "About" screen


Miscellaneous

 The Poolroom has been expanded
 Improved performance during level loading and player death
 Fixed a memory leak related to lights when running the game for prolonged periods of time
 Players may opt to flush themselves
 Changed the colour of the Bepis cup under advisement by the Aldercourt Legal Services Bureau
 Fixed bugs related to looping through the level - If you still get stuck outside of the level loop, I'll never develop another game again
 Various Bug fixes
 Removed Herobrine(??)

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements, Music, Motion Blur Removal, and BREATHING
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Version 0.9.75

Gameplay Enhancements:


 Motion Blur Slider: Players can now adjust the intensity of motion blur to their preference. Whether you prefer a cinematic feel or a crisp experience, find your sweet spot!
 Breathing System (Pointless Edition): I've added a breathing mechanic because… well, why not? Breathe rhythmically as you explore the game world. It might not impact gameplay, but it’s there!
 Menu Tweaks: The Settings and In-Game Options menus have been tweaked due to the addition of new elements. Hopefully the new layouts don't suck ;).


Bug Fixes and Improvements:

 Music Speakers: Two speakers have been added to the room with the glass doors. No more eerie silence! These play royalty free music, and can be disabled by turning the slider in the Game Options all the way down.
 Vanishing Anomaly Fix: Previously, the [spoiler]lady-vanishing[/spoiler] anomaly was a bit elusive. Turns out, I can't do math ;). Fixed now!
 Motion Blur Disable: Motion blur can be tweaked or entirely disabled by using the Motion Blur slider in the Settings menu.
 Movement Responsiveness: Movement has been fine-tuned to be more responsive.
 Breathing System (Still Pointless): Yes, we’re committed to pointlessness. Breathe in, breathe out. It won’t affect your stamina or health, but hey, immersion!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This patch addresses the following:


 Fixes an issue that could break then game if stopping at the wrong point in the starter hallway
 Fixed issues that would cause 2 anomalies to never spawn
 Fixed an audio issue in the starter hallway with certain buzzing lights
 Fixed an issue with the [spoiler]CCTV[/spoiler] anomaly if heading backwards before it is fully triggered
 Fixed an issue that caused the mouse to appear on screen if dying to certain anomalies


Please be aware that this also removes the "BONELESS" anomaly. It simply broke too many things and couldn't easily be fixed 😅 This anomaly will be removed from your save data without affecting anything else.
